body: Integration-owner rule (Opus2, 2026-11-16, my own deviation on the 97bc test ref, flagged by Sol-03d4 #2759). The test-ref bullet requires the frozen input's tree id and freeze fingerprint to be recorded on the item BEFORE the test-ref commit is created. Do it as separate steps: (1) capture the fingerprint and tree and verify the carry; (2) write the item note with both values; (3) only then git commit-tree and check that the ref is absent; (4) push and read back; (5) note the push. Never chain capture, commit-tree and push in one command ahead of the note. In the 97bc case the note came about a minute after the push, and the ruling went to the TermAl coordinator.
